scientific_integrity: General statement has a complete elementary shell-counting proof. The finite verifier corroborates, not certifies, all parameters. Self-review only; independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Only two-by-two upper triangular algebras over finite commutative chain rings; no general-local-ring or higher-rank conclusion. Earlier cyclic-chain extremal clique count is acknowledged as previously known. A broader determinantal-congruence theorem may imply the enumerators.
title: Two-pole commuting-tuple and clique enumerators for triangular algebras over finite chain rings
